lines.text: Many learners say: The shop is near with the station.
Better: The shop is near the station.
Near! I live near the park.

data.wrong: The shop is near with the station.
data.right: The shop is near the station.

native.tip: «Рядом с» — просто “near”, без “with”: “The shop is near the station.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “The shop is near with the station”? 😅 Русское «рядом с» подсказывает лишнее “with”, но после “near” оно не нужно. Правильно: “The shop is near the station.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “near.” После near не нужно with. Скажи вслух, что находится рядом с твоим домом: “My home is near the park.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: Say “near,” not “near with”: “The shop is near the station.”
en.caption: Do you also say “The shop is near with the station”? 😅 The Russian phrase adds “with,” but English just says near. Correct: “The shop is near the station.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
